Chapter 1257 15: A World Of Despair (Subscribe)

Chapter 1257 15: A World of Despair (Subscribe)

In a haze, Lin Yuan's consciousness gradually revived.

However, it seemed that his spiritual power had been eroded and suppressed, causing his mind to remain somewhat chaotic and unable to fully awaken.

Uncertain how much time had passed, Lin Yuan's spiritual power instinctively operated and finally expelled the corrosive aura.

The result of this.

Was that Lin Yuan woke up.

"Ugh..."

Lin Yuan only felt a splitting headache.

At the same time, he began to receive information from the outside world.

"Oh? You actually managed to come back to life?"

"To survive under the erosion of the 'demon', it's quite rare, quite rare indeed."

An old voice emerged nearby, tinged with astonishment.

Bang!

Countless pieces of information surged in Lin Yuan's mind, which were the memories of the 'original self'.

"This world is filled with endless demons, 'demons' are immortal and eternal, existing in the world. To fight against demons, one must become a cultivator? And I am a cultivator of the Qingyun Sect?"

Lin Yuan quickly sorted out the current situation he found himself in.

This world is boundless, and demons did not exist since ancient times; they originated from a transformative Heaven-Earth event millions of years ago.

Millions of years ago, cultivators ruled the world and dominated everything, but after that transformative Heaven-Earth event, the existence of 'demons' appeared, with demonic qi pervading, obstructing the cultivation of practitioners, while also gathering a large amount of demonic qi, giving birth to terrifying 'demons'.

The Qingyun Sect, where the 'original self' belonged, was a cultivator force before the Heaven-Earth transformation, having undergone numerous major demonic invasions.

However, compared to before the Heaven-Earth transformation, the Qingyun Sect had already declined significantly.

With the boundless demonic qi enveloping, the difficulty of cultivation for practitioners increased, resulting in fewer strong cultivators being born, and as the elder powerhouses gradually perished at the hands of demons, the Qingyun Sect was trending towards a shortage of successors.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

He saw a ragged old man standing beside him, who was curiously examining him.

"Elder Fang."

Lin Yuan moved his lips and began to speak.

The ragged old man was an elder of the Qingyun Sect, responsible for healing disciples injured by demons.

"Since you've woken up, I'll be on my way."

Elder Fang continued observing Lin Yuan for a moment, then turned and left.

"This body..." Lin Yuan watched Elder Fang disappear and began to sense the fine details of his body, immediately noticing something amiss.

As the Ancestor of Martial Arts, Lin Yuan's understanding of the body had reached an extraordinary height, and the body he now inhabited, although weak, faintly held almost limitless potential.

"I am not an exception, this is one of the effects brought on by the Heaven-Earth transformation."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

After the Heaven-Earth transformation, the world undoubtedly saw the emergence of terrifying 'demons', but life in this world simultaneously had its body nourished and replenished, surpassing pre-transformation in both strength and potential.

The body's strength brings a direct increase in power. Although the presence of demonic qi slowed cultivation progress, the body's enhancement was significantly accelerated.

This is also one of the keys for cultivators to resist demons post-transformation.

Without this support, the Qingyun Sect would have long perished during past major demonic invasions, let alone persisted until now.

"With such potential in the body, cultivating it to the extreme might surmount the body of the Chaos Void or the first Yuan World?" Lin Yuan marveled in his heart.

Whether in the Chaos Void or the first Yuan World, Lin Yuan's physical form was already terrifying, yet the physical body in this Fang Yuan World could exceed the former two? What's even more incredible is that such a body has become 'widespread' in this world?

Of course, due to the inability to perfectly harness it, the life in this world possesses bodies with infinite potential, yet they utterly lack knowledge to utilize it.

It is akin to primitive societies receiving nuclear weapons but treating them as stones.

Lin Yuan regulated his breathing and was soon able to recover slightly, managing to sit up from the bed.

Simultaneously, scenes flashed through his mind.

"Senior Brother Li actually entered into the demonic path?" Lin Yuan slightly furrowed his brows.

The injuries he sustained were directly related to Senior Brother Li's entry into the demonic path.

Senior Brother Li was the senior master of the Qingyun Sect, often leading many junior disciples to disperse the surrounding demonic qi.

A large accumulation of demonic qi could generate terrifying 'demons', so the Qingyun Sect disciples would regularly patrol the vicinity to disperse the gathered demonic qi and prevent the birth of 'demons'.

However, during the recent demonic qi dispersal action, Senior Brother Li, leading the team, secretly absorbed and devoured the source of a dense demonic qi.

This scene was witnessed by the 'original self', and Senior Brother Li directly acted, using demonic qi to erode the 'original self's' mind and consciousness, creating the illusion of perishing at the hands of demons.

The 'original self's' mind and consciousness should have indeed been completely eroded and perished by demonic qi, but was immediately replaced by Lin Yuan, and with Lin Yuan's spiritual will, naturally resisted the subsequent erosion, which is why he appeared to 'come back to life' in Elder Fang's eyes.

"Entering the demonic path..."

Lin Yuan's thoughts spread out.

After the Heaven-Earth transformation, endless demonic qi poured into the world, having an unprecedented impact on cultivators. Upon witnessing the might of demons, two voices gradually emerged within cultivators.

One was to persist in the current cultivation system, this group was also known as traditional cultivators.

The other, however, was to enter the demonic path, becoming one who enters the demonic path.

In the eyes of this group of cultivators, demons are immortal, and to confront demons, one must become demons, using demonic power to fight demons.

Thus, the path of entering the demonic path emerged.

So-called entering the demonic path, meant that cultivators forsake everything, beginning to endure the baptism of demonic qi, during which they would be subject to many influences of the demonic qi.
